messages.author: 5b374b1d84f6eb03
messages.subject: occasionLenght (detectionHistory) shorter than 1 day?
parts:
Dear all,
I am building some detectionHistory tables but I see that the shortest occasion length is 1 day (if I understand well). I am interested on having shorter periods, i.e. a quarter of a day. Is there any workaround/solution I have not imagined?

Thanks in advance
Bernat

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: occasionLenght (detectionHistory) shorter than 1 day?
parts:
Hi Bernat,
currently occasion lengths shorter than 1 day are not supported, and I cannot think of a simple workaround at the moment.
Jürgen

messages.author: 5b374b1d84f6eb03
messages.subject: Re: occasionLenght (detectionHistory) shorter than 1 day?
parts: Thanks Jürgen, maybe something to add in the future :-).... The only solution I see is subsetting the recordTable.

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: occasionLenght (detectionHistory) shorter than 1 day?
parts:
Hi Bernat,
subsetting the record Table is a great idea for a quick fix for your request for shorter than 1-day occasions. If you have some code and are willing to share, I am sure other users would appreciate it.
Once I have a little more time I may try to include this feature in a new release. 
Thank you!
